figures.caption: Figure 1. Reproduction of the simple GPLA simulations from Safavi et al. [32]. (A) Example transient LFP with a representative interval highlighted for visualization. (B) gPLV across four spike–LFP coupling models. (C–F) Four coupling scenarios: globally synchronized spiking, a phase progression across units, clustered phase locking, and uncoupled spiking. In each row, the left panel shows a schematic of the locking structure, the middle panel shows the LFP together with spike trains inside the selected window, and the right panel shows the resulting spike vector in the complex plane.
